spec.name: Paintball Popper Shooter
spec.description: Paintball Popper Shooter: compact sporting equipment with a charcoal polymer receiver, orange accents, a prominent top hopper, silver pressure cylinder, rubber grip and short barrel. Centered for right-hand item use, with the muzzle facing -Z. Rounded stepped construction and clean sporting details; no text or military styling.
